issue.title: Two ACE monitor PNG goldens are mutually stale: each was regenerated without the other monitor-rendering commit's change
issue.description:
`just test-visual` fails deterministically on two ACE Agents-tab PNG goldens that were added one commit apart by two parallel monitor-rendering tales. Each tale regenerated only its own new golden, against a tree that did not contain the other tale's change, so each golden is now stale with respect to the other's rendering.

- `tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_families.py::test_settled_monitor_lane_badge_png_snapshot` (golden `agents_settled_monitor_lane_badge_120x40.png`, added by 845253505) still shows the pre-9102c9efb roster label `AGENT (monitor)` where the code now renders `MONITOR`.
- `tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_family_panel.py::test_family_conversation_monitor_phase_png_snapshot` (golden `agents_family_conversation_monitor_120x40.png`, added by 9102c9efb) lacks the settled-monitor amber gear badge that 845253505 added to family container rows.

FOUND BY the sase-ps land agent (2026-08-18) while running `just test-visual` as part of that epic's landing verification. sase-ps (runner-slot occupancy) touches none of the files behind either diff; its own stale golden in the same run (`config_center_statistics_runners_120x40`) was regenerated and committed separately as epic work. Neither 9102c9efb nor 845253505 is a phase of an in-progress epic -- both carry tale-plan `SASE_PLAN` metadata (`202608/monitor_phase_rendering.md`, `202608/settled_monitor_gear_chip.md`) and no `SASE_BEAD` -- so there is no active epic to attach this to.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake:
Both nodes fail deterministically with content-scale diffs, not sub-pixel renderer noise, and each diff is an exact, explainable text change rather than timing drift.

`test_settled_monitor_lane_badge_png_snapshot` (agents_settled_monitor_lane_badge_120x40): 19297/1520532 changed pixels (1.27%), 19272 material. The FAMILY MEMBERS roster rows render `MONITOR` in the actual frame where the golden holds `AGENT (monitor)`. That string changed in 9102c9efb ("feat(ace): render monitor phases with amber gear MONITOR"), which gave monitor roles their own phase label. The golden was added one commit later by 845253505 but captured the pre-9102c9efb roster label.

`test_family_conversation_monitor_phase_png_snapshot` (agents_family_conversation_monitor_120x40): 81719/1520532 changed pixels (5.37%), 81425 material. The actual frame renders an amber settled-monitor gear badge on the family container row (`visual-family-root (MONITORED) [gear]1 visual-family`) that the golden lacks; the extra badge widens the left pane and shifts the whole right prompt panel by one cell. That badge was added in 845253505 ("feat(ace): render settled-monitor gear count on clan/family container rows"). This golden was added by 9102c9efb and captured the pre-845253505 container row.

So the two commits landed in sequence and each regenerated only its own new golden against a tree that did not contain the other's change, leaving both mutually stale. The failures are symmetric and reproduce identically on every run.

Reproduced on clean master 88d2a1582 in workspace sase_14 after a from-scratch `just install`: `just test-visual` -> 4 failed, 711 passed, 1 skipped in 379.62s. Both nodes were among the four. Confirmed still present after rebasing onto 725cdb11d.

Fix: confirm each diff shows only the intended label/badge change, then regenerate both goldens with `just test-visual -- --sase-update-visual-snapshots <node>` and re-run the visual suite.

Impact is contained: the visual suite is excluded from `just test`, `just test-cost`, `just check`, and `just check-full`, so no landing agent is blocked; only `just test-visual` is red.

CONTEXT: implementing tribe_panel_settled_monitor_gear.md (tale, adds a grey settled-monitor gear badge to Agents-tab panel titles) in workspace sase_22. My plan independently regenerates both goldens this bead tracks (agents_settled_monitor_lane_badge_120x40.png and agents_family_conversation_monitor_120x40.png) via --sase-update-visual-snapshots, since my change also touches their rendered titles. My regeneration will capture both this bead's pending fixes (MONITOR label, amber container-row badge) and my own title-badge addition in the same commit, so this bead's underlying staleness should be resolved once my change lands -- verify against the new goldens rather than duplicating the regeneration.

Separately: this run's reproduction is on a workspace base (HEAD 4cf7672bd) that predates origin/master commit da8be0ea9 ('test(visual): rebaseline the Statistics runners golden for the new legend'), which already fixes the third stale golden config_center_statistics_runners_120x40.png mentioned in the description as 'regenerated and committed separately as epic work' -- confirming that note is accurate and current.
